stories.headline: Stop counting tokens, start counting what ships
stories.dek: When a developer gives an AI agent a coding task, the agent does more than answer once. It plans, generates code, runs tests, and repeats the process to correct errors. A single task can use 10 to 50 times more tokens than a basic chat prompt. The more useful the agent becomes, the more calls…

stories.headline: SpaceX’s big mobile carrier plans could reportedly involve buying Boost Mobile

The deal, which comes as SpaceX aims to make Starlink a "major" mobile carrier, reportedly involves the Elon Musk-owned company acquiring Boost
